question_text: Describe binary search for a target name in a list sorted ascending. Include how absence is detected.
adaptation_rationale: Binary-search construction/tracing explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Keep lower/upper bounds. Compare target with middle value. Return if equal; otherwise discard lower or upper half according to comparison. Repeat until found or bounds cross; crossing means absent.

marking_points.criterion: Compares target to middle and detects equality.
Terminates absent when search interval empty.
